items.title: ExxonMobil Holdings (XOM) Gets Mozambique Approval For $30 Billion Rovuma LNG Plan
items.summary: ExxonMobil Holdings (NYSE:XOM) secured Mozambican government approval for its redesigned Rovuma LNG project, a roughly US$30b development. The revised Rovuma LNG plan includes higher production capacity and a layout aimed at materially lower emissions compared with the earlier concept. Regulatory clearance positions ExxonMobil to consider a final investment decision on Rovuma LNG by the end of this year.
